explanation: Compared against OEIS A233549: a(n) is the number of ways to write n = p + q (q > 0) with p and (φ(p)φ(q))⁴ + 1 prime; conjecture (i) is a(n) > 0 for all n > 2. The definition filters primes p < n, so q = n - p ≥ 1, and the tests match the data 0, 0, 1, 2, 2. The statement asserts 0 < a n for n > 2. Faithful.
